name: Ostrun's Vault
description: A small, perfectly empty tomb-vault, cut into a hillside in the north by the first Lightbearer, for the heir who would come after.

v1_hall.name: The Vault Door
v1_hall.description: A square hall of black stone, dry and silent. Dust lies on the floor in a thick, undisturbed skin. Steps climb to the door above; a passage leads on.

v1_passage.name: The Dry Passage
v1_passage.description: A narrow passage with a ceiling you could touch, and walls cut so truly they could have been poured. It bends, and a stair goes down at the bend.

v2_landing.name: The Lower Landing
v2_landing.description: A small landing at the foot of the stair, with a doorway east. The air is colder, and quite still.

v2_cross.name: The Crossing
v2_cross.description: Two passages meet here under a low vault. The one leading north ends in a lit doorway, though nothing here should be lit.

v2_sanctum.name: The Sanctum of the Tablet
v2_sanctum.description: A small round chamber. In the middle stands one upright slab of black stone, carved with letters. Nothing else is here, and nothing else is needed.
